mechanism: recombinative-replay (RANK3 imagination): gamma-WTA phase-organized replay at a shared branch node, DIRECT full spiking simulation (not the extracted-matrix proxy)
headline: NEGATIVE 0/6: direct spiking gamma-organized recombination does NOT produce learned-selective novel recombination. The network reaches B (co-ignite ~1.0) but the recomb readout is NOT learned-selective -- the SCRAMBLE control (mean 0.633) shows MORE recomb than the learned MAIN condition (mean 0.166) on every seed, so the recomb events are non-specific exits, not learned recombination. Confirms the RANK3 extracted-matrix-proxy boundary via full direct simulation.
